source: Ported from agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh (node, uv, gh, codex, claude) plus fresh 2026-09-22 fetches for qmd, mcporter, rtk, ai-memory, context-mode. Each archive was downloaded into a disposable worktree temp directory and hashed with sha256sum; npm entries were additionally cross-checked against `npm view <pkg> dist.integrity` (sha512, base64) computed with `openssl dgst -sha512 -binary | base64` over the same downloaded tarball -- all five matched exactly.

tools.install_note: Verified against https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/SHASUMS256.txt fetched 2026-09-22; also matches the pin already carried in agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh. Extract with --strip-components=1 into tools/node-24.21.0; symlink bin/{node,npm,npx,corepack}.
Verified against the release's .sha256 sidecar fetched 2026-09-22; matches the existing agent-lab devcontainer pin. Archive also contains uvx; install both.

v2.101.0 was GitHub's actual 'latest' release for cli/cli on 2026-09-22 (queried via `gh api repos/cli/cli/releases/latest`); hash verified against the release's gh_2.101.0_checksums.txt. Binary is at bin/gh inside the archive.

npm registry tarball for @openai/codex@0.155.1 (thin wrapper package, 4904 bytes); npm dist.integrity sha512-02fAAGyBtlA1zPjEo3kTj/bOSYbPz5DvjLwRZJdV7weFFEDzNFOMjQGmZ/+5CuirYV0hE+AZTrnjzwXYU4AdAQ== matches a fresh openssl sha512/base64 digest of the same download. `npm install --global --prefix tools/codex-0.155.1 @openai/codex@0.155.1`. The complete native package (codex-code-mode-host, bundled rg) used by the agent-lab devcontainer script is a separate, larger GitHub release asset; this pin follows the npm alternative the task specified.

minimum version; native auto-update on the latest channel. Raised from 2.1.280 (1e08503dbdf3c2cb0d706d32f3408277388d1c76ef108673e8fe42c1b322925b, verified 2026-09-23 by downloading the linux-x64 binary and re-hashing it) in step with the macOS pin, since shared components keep one version on both platforms: 2.1.281 fixes a recursive rm of command-substitution output running unprompted in auto and --dangerously-skip-permissions mode. This sha256 is the 2.1.281 manifest.json's platforms.linux-x64.checksum (fetched 2026-09-24, size 237375560); the linux-x64 binary was not re-downloaded or re-hashed for it, and fetch() verifies the served bytes against it before anything runs. Superseded the prior npm-wrapper pin (2.1.278, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1) once the native installer became the reference path: fetch the binary, verify its sha256, then run `"$bin" install 2.1.281`, matching ~/codex-ecosystem/bin/bootstrap-linux.sh's own claude-code step. The installed binary self-manages ~/.local/share/claude/versions and the ~/.local/bin/claude launcher and auto-updates on the latest channel from there; this pin is a floor, not a ceiling: adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh's install_native (identical to bootstrap-macos.sh's since 2026-09-24) keeps a ~/.local/bin/claude whose --version already reports 2.1.281 or newer, logging `Kept installed claude-code <version>` with nothing downloaded or installed, and runs the checksum-verified install only when that launcher is missing, older or unreadable, so re-running the bootstrap never moves a newer auto-updated install back to this pin. No DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER opt-out is set.

version_probe.note: The pin is a floor: the native launcher auto-updates on the latest channel, so any version at or above the pin passes.

tools.install_note: npm dist.integrity sha512-zjfVwrObPB618B6x8SdhlGv/tX9OxRHsbQnr5DUtBvqPK6HGQ27lM+9/BAY5okpjrHVnW56hLyDkqoTcsrVLzA== matched. `npm install --global --prefix tools/qmd-2.8.3 @tobilu/qmd@2.8.3`, matching recipes/README.md.

Verified against the v0.50.0 release's checksums.txt fetched 2026-09-25 (`sha256sum --check --strict`: OK; the checksums.txt sha256 4c7116898ae812960dfa0de3b3acc5406a0da49209f0ad7bed4d4ed8c4785048 equals the GitHub API asset digest), matching recipes/README.md's rtk 0.50.0 row; qualified against 0.49.0 and switched on nativestack-5975wx-20260925 (evidence/receipts/rtk-050-qualification-20260925.json). The bootstrap installs the binary only: a host that runs the Claude hook also needs the ~/.config/rtk/config.toml exclude_commands in recipes/README.md, or 0.50.0's `git show <rev>:<path> | tail` blob window is live.

Verified 2026-09-25 against three upstream values that agree (by the qualification run at 22:43Z and its independent verifier at 23:10Z): the v2.4.1 release's ai-memory-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256 sidecar, the GitHub API asset digest (16,026,020 bytes) and the checksum list in the release body; the API digest was re-checked on 2026-09-26 before the cutover; the archive's ai-memory binary has sha256 dec065a82478bec92a0c34323662af7e7ad616b222586356814b4875053aa8dd, and the release has no artifact attestation (HTTP 404), an unsigned tag and is not immutable. Matches recipes/README.md's ai-memory row (official akitaonrails/ai-memory v2.4.1 archive, tag commit 433a19f3d54dea287571b1423591db2a89965fa9). On nativestack-5975wx-20260925, 2.4.0 replaced 2.3.2 on 2026-09-25 and 2.4.1 replaced 2.4.0 on 2026-09-26, each after a rehearsal on restored copies and a cold-copy cutover (evidence/receipts/ai-memory-240-qualification-20260925.json and ai-memory-241-qualification-20260925.json); that is one host's state, not evidence about any other Linux host. Migrations are forward-only: 2.4.1 migrates a 2.3.2 store V64 -> V67 and a 2.4.0 store V66 -> V67 when `serve` first opens it, an older binary then refuses that store, and no automatic pre-migration archive is written for a 2.x store. On a host with an existing store, stop the service and take an at-rest copy of the data directory before the service restarts on this binary, then re-run `ai-memory install-hooks --apply` for each client (the hook commands name the versioned prefix).

npm dist.integrity sha512-/6pvMjFPlCtFU3NhzWEV8vj2EwvbY2nisc8XYDwtPiyApj8v6A+B0Va5ul018oqSEkw7BiKCLoazBc4l+8QsdQ== matched, and the sha256 above equals the GitHub release v0.14.1 asset digest and its checksums.txt (checked 2026-09-25); `npm audit signatures` verified the registry signatures and mcporter's SLSA provenance (release.yml at refs/tags/v0.14.1, commit 93e0916cafe2d624b94271e31b75ca681a016514). `npm install --global --prefix tools/mcporter-0.14.1 mcporter@0.14.1`, matching recipes/README.md. Requires Node >=24, and `ps` on the PATH of whatever launches the mcporter daemon: 0.14.x runs `ps` from PATH (0.13.13 ran /bin/ps), and without it the daemon cannot connect keep-alive servers and `mcporter daemon stop` refuses. Qualified against 0.13.13 and switched on nativestack-5975wx-20260925 (evidence/receipts/mcporter-0141-qualification-20260925.json); that is one host's state, not evidence about any other Linux host.

npm dist.integrity sha512-94JIaFuLjF9SO2BsGTrbGtyT44K95+9OC8BdbaL/UT76xOkanJLfUR5CzmNw+GELXZQqH4nBrKg9wjBnSFkVnQ== matched. recipes/README.md flags that the npm context-mode@1.0.169 release is a DIFFERENT source revision from the native plugin pin (git 6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b installed via `codex plugin marketplace add` / `claude plugin marketplace add`) and is not a substitute for full plugin evidence. This pin installs the npm CLI package only (`npm install --global --prefix tools/context-mode-1.0.169 context-mode@1.0.169`) so the script can place an executable on PATH; it does NOT install or replace the client-native plugin, and does not by itself establish the plugin-level acceptance recorded elsewhere in the catalog.

version_probe.note: No version flag: every argv other than its named subcommands and --help falls through to starting its MCP stdio server, so the package version is read from npm metadata instead (observed 2026-09-25 with context-mode 1.0.169).

tools.install_note: 2026-09-25: 0.1.8 was qualified against 0.1.7 and switched on nativestack-5975wx-20260925 (evidence/receipts/markitdown-018-qualification-20260925.json); that is one host's state, not evidence about any other Linux host. The sdist at the URL above (69,112 bytes) and the wheel uv installs, markitdown-0.1.8-py3-none-any.whl (89,737 bytes, sha256 de7375a50578a39bcbbf13b48c67d99033d988e0ae8ad25af46ed432dbe4cbab), were downloaded and sha256-hashed; both match PyPI's published digests (https://pypi.org/pypi/markitdown/0.1.8/json urls[].digests.sha256 and the PEP 691 Simple API, read 2026-09-25). install_pin's *-uv-tool case runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 markitdown==0.1.8` into UV_TOOL_DIR, so the entry point runs in its own environment. uv resolves the pinned version from PyPI and does not check this sha256; it is recorded as an independent artifact cross-check and satisfies this catalog's fail-closed null-sha256 refusal.

PyPI package `headroom-ai` (repository headroomlabs-ai/headroom) 0.37.0 with the `[mcp]` extra recipes/README.md's upstream-MCP recipe installs (`headroom mcp serve`). url/sha256 above are the `manylinux_2_28_x86_64` wheel this exact platform resolves (PyPI JSON https://pypi.org/pypi/headroom-ai/0.37.0/json urls[].digests.sha256, read 2026-09-25); the wheel was independently downloaded and re-hashed and matches exactly. `install_uv_tool` now takes an optional `package` (this entry's `headroom-ai[mcp]`; every other uv-tool pin keeps falling back to its own `.id`, unchanged) so the installed spec is `uv tool install --python 3.13 'headroom-ai[mcp]==0.37.0'`, exactly recipes/README.md's command and the version manifests/stack.json already pins. `headroom --version` prints `headroom, version 0.37.0` and exits; confirmed 2026-09-25 in an isolated `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` scratch install, not the shared host copy.

2026-09-25 addition to complete the `token-efficiency` profile's Linux pin coverage. Upstream's pyproject.toml declares `version = "2.0.0.dev0"` with no corresponding PyPI release of that dev version (confirmed reading it at this commit, and the PyPI distribution name is `serena-agent`, not `serena`), so this pin is a source pin: an exact 40-hex commit on oraios/serena (confirmed present with `git cat-file -e c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143^{commit}` and via the GitHub commits API, both 2026-09-25), not a downloaded-archive sha256. `sha256` is null; `tests/test_adoption_bootstrap.py`'s pin-hash test accepts a null sha256 here only because `kind` is `uv-tool-from-git` and `commit` is a verified 40-hex string -- every other kind still fails closed on a null sha256 exactly as before. The new `uv-tool-from-git` kind's `install_uv_tool_from_git` runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143` -- the same commit and command already in adoption/bootstrap.md step 4a and recipes/README.md's `serena` row -- into the same `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` layout `install_uv_tool` uses, then reads back the resulting `uv-receipt.toml` and refuses (exit 1) unless it records this exact commit, so a stale prior install of a different revision can never pass silently. `serena --version` (a Click `is_eager` option that exits before any subcommand runs, confirmed reading src/serena/cli.py at this commit) printed exactly `Serena 2.0.0.dev0` with no `-<commit>` suffix from a fresh, non-editable install (its version helper in src/serena/__init__.py appends one only when its own installed directory is itself a git checkout, which a `uv tool install` from a git source is not); confirmed directly 2026-09-25 in an isolated `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` scratch install, not the shared host copy.

tools.install_note: 2026-09-25 addition to complete the `token-efficiency` profile's Linux pin coverage: mirrors adoption/pins-macos-arm64.json's existing `socraticode` entry (same version, url, sha256 and `--ignore-scripts`). AGPL-3.0-only; upstream commercial alternative. `npm install --global --prefix tools/socraticode-1.14.0 --ignore-scripts socraticode@1.14.0`, exactly recipes/README.md's documented recipe, which this pin now also drives through the bootstrap script instead of only a manual install. `--ignore-scripts` (this pin's own `ignore_scripts: true` field, read by `install_npm`) skips native postinstall/build steps. Only a reviewed archive hash, not a claim of a working native codebase-index handshake on this host.

version_probe.note: No argument parsing at all: every invocation, --help and --version included, starts its MCP stdio server (dist/index.js never reads process.argv; observed 2026-09-25 with socraticode 1.14.0, matching the macOS pin's own note), so the package version is read from npm metadata instead. Never run `socraticode --version` or with no arguments on a real install -- it starts the server.
